name: FFS_MSG_AGENT
description: Stores a list of delivery channels.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: An unique ID of outbound_configuration.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The external interface status .

columns.name: IS_EXTERNAL
columns.description: Is External System. Values - 'false', 'true'.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The External Interface Name. Madatory unique field.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The server description (optional).

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: The Message Sending Method. Values - 'email', 'external_system', 'bics', 'dbaas', 'ics', 'oac', 'ocx', 'knowledge', 'oce', 'okm', 'hcm', 'ocm', 'oci', 'fusion', 'oauth'.

columns.name: SUBMETHOD
columns.description: Additional identifier for message method 'external_system'.

columns.name: DETACH
columns.description: This flag defines if the a standalone thread should be used to process messages of this type (values: 1 - yes, 0 - no) .

columns.name: PATTERN
columns.description: The SOAP message content template. Please note that the message pattern can also be defined using the Agent tag body. .

columns.name: BULK_SIZE
columns.description: The maximal number of messages per request .

columns.name: HAS_GET_INFO
columns.description: This flag defines if the agent supports the get_info SOAP function (1 - yes, 0 - no) .

columns.name: SEND_MESSAGE_SOAP_ACTION
columns.description: It is the value of the 'SOAPAction' header for the send_message call. (NONE - suppress the header) .

columns.name: DROP_MESSAGE_SOAP_ACTION
columns.description: It is the value of the 'SOAPAction' header for the drop_message call. (NONE - suppress the header) .

columns.name: GET_MESSAGE_STATUS_SOAP_ACTION
columns.description: It is the value of the 'SOAPAction' header for the get_message_status call. (NONE - suppress the header) .

columns.name: TLS
columns.description: Message agent TLS encyption flag.

columns.name: TLS_VERSION
columns.description: It defines a security protocol to be used for the HTTPS connection. (works if tls = 1; default - auto select) .

columns.name: COMPANY_ID
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: WATERMARK
columns.description: Datetime of the last modification.

columns.name: DISABLE_WEAK_PASSWORD_HASH
columns.description: Obsolete field that specified whether the MD5 algorithm hash is used to validate the password. MD5 algorithm is not used for hashing anymore.

columns.name: ALLOW_HTTP_BASIC
columns.description: Allow to send http basic authentication headers.

columns.name: HTTP_VERSION
columns.description: HTTP version for delivery channel.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
